summary.text: Michael Todd is the Republican candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Jennifer Cassidy in a race with no incumbent.
A retired special education teacher, he has served Grain Valley as an alderman and as mayor.

paragraphs.text: Michael Todd is a lifelong Grain Valley resident who attended Grain Valley schools and then the University of Central Missouri, according to his Ballotpedia survey responses.
He earned a bachelor's degree in elementary education and a master's degree in school administration.
Todd taught special education for 26 years in the Grain Valley and Blue Springs school districts and retired from Blue Springs in 2025.
Todd said he has been a Grain Valley elected official for 20 years, six as an alderman and 14 as mayor.
He also chairs the Grain Valley Fair Board and serves on the boards of the Grain Valley Chamber of Commerce and the Grain Valley Historical Society.
Todd's stated campaign priorities include infrastructure funding, limiting purchases of large numbers of single-family homes by institutional investors, and protecting Second Amendment rights.
